probe.name: Test the connection
probe.description: Signs in and finds what the connection's token can do.

list-commits.name: List commits
list-commits.description: The latest commits of a branch.

list-change-requests.name: List pull or merge requests
list-change-requests.description: Open pull or merge requests: of a repository, yours, or waiting for your review.

list-pipelines.name: List pipelines
list-pipelines.description: The latest pipelines of a repository.

resolve-remote.name: Find a repository by its git remote
resolve-remote.description: The repository of this connection whose clone URL is the git remote, if any.

extension.name: Provider extension
extension.description: A read-only operation only one provider has.

open-repository.name: Open repository
open-repository.description: Opens a repository's page in the browser.

open-change-requests.name: Open pull or merge requests
open-change-requests.description: Opens the pull or merge requests of a repository, or yours.

open-issue.name: Open issue
open-issue.description: Opens an issue in the browser.

pipeline-status.name: Pipeline status
pipeline-status.description: The latest pipeline of a branch or of a pull or merge request.

create-change-request.name: Open a pull or merge request
create-change-request.description: Opens a pull or merge request from a branch, or finds the one already open.

trigger-pipeline.name: Start a pipeline
trigger-pipeline.description: Starts a pipeline on a branch (GitLab: with variables).

wait-pipeline.name: Wait for a pipeline
wait-pipeline.description: Waits until a pipeline ends, at most ten minutes.

errors.unauthorized: The server refused the connection's token: reconnect it.
errors.insufficient-scope: The token lacks a permission this needs.
errors.not-found: Not found, or the token cannot see it.
errors.rate-limited: The server's rate limit is reached; try again later.
errors.provider-error: The server answered with an error.
errors.invalid-response: The server's answer is not what was expected.
errors.invalid-repository: Choose a repository of this connection.
errors.invalid-ref: Not a branch, tag or commit name.
errors.invalid-variables: A pipeline variable is not NAME=value.
errors.unreachable: Can't reach the server (network or VPN?).
errors.redirect-refused: The server redirected the request elsewhere, which is refused.
errors.connection-missing: The connection is not on this computer.
errors.capability-unsupported: This server or provider cannot do that.
errors.needs-confirmation: This action asks first, so it does not run unattended.
errors.url-not-allowed: Only pages of the connection's server can be opened.
errors.timed-out: The pipeline did not end in time.

plugin.name: Git Providers
plugin.description: Repositories, pull and merge requests, pipelines and issues of the GitHub and GitLab servers you connect, each with its own token.

permissions.connections: Talks to the GitHub and GitLab servers you connect, each with its own token, and nowhere else.
permissions.openUrl: Opens repositories, pull or merge requests, pipelines and issues of your connections in the browser.
permissions.dialogs: Asks you to confirm before it opens a merge request or starts a pipeline from a key.
